name: Ensemble pour les rivières : préservation, entretien et restauration des rivières de Mayotte
summary: Call for projects from the Mayotte Department-Region giving grants to local associations and communes to remove waste and debris jams from the island's rivers, mobilise residents and replant riverbanks.
